mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, project_name, sns, info_code, info_code_variant, ietm_location_code, originator, originator_name, issue_no, in_work, version_type, issue_type, tech_name, info_name, cm_node_id, cm_node_name, cm_node_path, is_latest, status, checkout_user, checkout_time, checkout_dm_id, workflow_instance_id, workflow_status, dmc_code, create_time, update_time FROM ietm_data_module WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = '1' AND is_latest = '1' ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, project_id, project_name, sns, info_code, info_code_variant, ietm_location_code, originator, originator_name, issue_no, in_work, version_type, issue_type, tech_name, info_name, cm_node_id, cm_node_name, cm_node_path, is_latest, status, checkout_user, checkout_time, checkout_dm_id, workflow_instance_id, workflow_status, dmc_code, create_time, update_time FROM ietm_data_module WHERE status = '1' AND is_latest = '1'
AND (cm_node_id = #{cmNodeId} OR cm_node_path LIKE #{cmNodeId} || '%')
AND cm_node_id = #{cmNodeId}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, issue_no, in_work, dmc_code, dm_content FROM ietm_data_module WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('1', '2')

choose.when: SELECT NULL AS "refId" FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0

SELECT r.id AS "refId", r.target_dm_id AS "targetDmId", d.dmc_code AS "targetDmcCode", d.tech_name AS "targetTechName", d.info_name AS "targetInfoName", r.ref_type AS "refType", r.ref_position AS "refPosition" FROM ietm_dm_reference r LEFT JOIN ietm_data_module d ON r.target_dm_id = d.id AND d.status = '1' WHERE r.source_dm_id = #{dmId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id AS "refId", r.source_dm_id AS "sourceDmId", d.dmc_code AS "sourceDmcCode", d.tech_name AS "sourceTechName", d.info_name AS "sourceInfoName", r.ref_type AS "refType", r.ref_position AS "refPosition" FROM ietm_dm_reference r LEFT JOIN ietm_data_module d ON r.source_dm_id = d.id AND d.status = '1' WHERE r.target_dm_id = #{dmId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS "refId" FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0

mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.project_id, t1.project_name, t1.sns, t1.info_code, t1.info_code_variant, t1.ietm_location_code, t1.originator, t1.originator_name, t1.issue_no, t1.in_work, t1.version_type, t1.issue_type, t1.tech_name, t1.info_name, t1.cm_node_id, t1.cm_node_name, t1.cm_node_path, t1.is_latest, t1.status, t1.checkout_user, t1.checkout_time, t1.checkout_dm_id, t1.workflow_instance_id, t1.workflow_status, t1.dmc_code, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.dm_type, t1.security, t1.issue_date, t1.language_iso_code, t1.country_iso_code, t1.rpc, t1.rpc_name, -- 从流程视图获取动态字段 v.activityalias_ AS activityalias_, -- 流程当前步骤（实时计算） v.currenthandler_ AS currenthandler_ -- 当前待办人（实时） FROM ietm_data_module t1 LEFT JOIN v_wf_instance v ON t1.id = v.formid_ WHERE t1.id = #{id} AND t1.status = '1'

SELECT t1.id, t1.project_id, t1.project_name, t1.sns, t1.info_code, t1.info_code_variant, t1.ietm_location_code, t1.originator, t1.originator_name, t1.issue_no, t1.in_work, t1.version_type, t1.issue_type, t1.tech_name, t1.info_name, t1.cm_node_id, t1.cm_node_name, t1.cm_node_path, t1.is_latest, t1.status, t1.checkout_user, t1.checkout_time, t1.checkout_dm_id, t1.workflow_instance_id, t1.workflow_status, t1.dmc_code, t1.create_time, t1.update_time, t1.dm_type, t1.issue_date, t1.language_iso_code, t1.country_iso_code, (SELECT MAX(t2.type_name) FROM ietm_dm_type t2 WHERE t2.type_code = t1.dm_type AND t2.status = '1') AS dm_type_name FROM ietm_data_module t1 WHERE t1.status = '1' AND t1.is_latest = '1'
AND t1.version_type = '1'
AND t1.cm_node_id IN ( SELECT id FROM ietm_project_configuration_management START WITH id = #{cmNodeId} CONNECT BY PRIOR id = pid )
AND t1.cm_node_id = #{cmNodeId}
AND t1.dmc_code LIKE '%' || #{dmc} || '%'
AND t1.tech_name LIKE '%' || #{techName} || '%'
AND t1.info_name LIKE '%' || #{infoName} || '%'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ietm_dm_type t3 WHERE t3.type_code = t1.dm_type AND t3.status = '1' AND t3.type_name LIKE '%' || #{dmTypeName} || '%' )
ORDER BY t1.dmc_code
